capabilities: Step through folder notes in File explorer order
Show navigator bars above and below the note
List the folder in a pinnable folder map
Open virtual folder notes for subfolders
Delete the current file and open the next item
extras: An interactive demo vault documents every feature and ships with each release; beta installs go through BRAT. Sorting follows the File explorer order, including custom-sort plugins' order.
problem: Obsidian has no way to step from one note to the next within a folder, so you must return to the File explorer and click the next note every time.
summary: Folder navigation plugin that steps through notes in File explorer order with navigator bars, a folder map and virtual folder notes.
